findings.issue: No PII scrubbing or redaction in logger — generic pino instance without sensitive field filtering
findings.impact: If any catch block logs request body or user data, PII (email, name, phone) could appear in logs
findings.fix: Add pino redaction config for sensitive fields: email, phone, full_name, secret, token, password — use redact: ['req.headers.authorization', 'email', 'phone']

findings.issue: PII columns (email, full_name, phone, avatar_url) in profiles table stored without column-level encryption
findings.impact: PII accessible to any query with sufficient RLS bypass; no encryption-at-rest for sensitive user data
findings.fix: Implement application-level encryption for phone and full_name fields; add column encryption note to schema docs

findings.issue: No GDPR compliance documentation, data processing register, or DPA reference found in docs
findings.impact: Cannot demonstrate GDPR compliance without documented data flows and retention schedules
findings.fix: Create docs/compliance/gdpr.md with data inventory, retention schedule, and subject access request procedure

findings.issue: Consent routes exist but no documented consent types, withdrawal procedure, or audit trail linkage
findings.impact: Users cannot easily withdraw consent or see what they consented to
findings.fix: Document consent types, add GET /consent/types endpoint, add consent withdrawal audit event
